evidence_level: Independent symbolic prose review; not machine-checked, not an experiment.
overall_disposition: Accept scoped mathematical claims and conservative primitive upper bounds, with explicit qualifications.

claims.claim: Small-tail polynomial congruence and exact divisibility
claims.qualification: No guard needed for divisibility; sigma may vary.

claims.claim: Strict |c_small|<4^R and equality of filtered gcds
claims.qualification: Guard needed for fractional-part identification; gcd(D,N)=1.
R>=2, unit steps, guard at all points; necessary, not sufficient.

claims.claim: Uniform depth and subpolynomial quotient bound
claims.qualification: Constants and threshold independent of a0, signs, bounded or growing R.

claims.claim: No proper filtered gcd on leastprime(N)>=N^eta
claims.qualification: Each fixed eta>0 and sufficiently large N; includes prime powers; no individual-digit or general lower bound.

claims.claim: Truncation and degree of r polynomial
claims.qualification: Full denominator hypothesis; distant tail uses integral raw coefficients, not false N-divisibility.
Actual unwrapped progression of unit scalar inputs; M for computation, NM for comparison proof.
No small-tail guard; R=1 quotient identically zero.

claims.claim: Coefficient recurrence and paid batch inverses
claims.qualification: Check through 2R+1; j<R recurrence inversions alone do not certify D_R.
Width is compatible; denominator/unit-point branches must still be checked; no supply promise.
No inverse of point differences, distinctness or roots-of-unity assumption; supplied input reading charged.

claims.claim: Single-stencil soft O(R^2 log N) cost
claims.qualification: Fast integer primitives; includes coefficient setup, checks, weights, division and gcd.

claims.claim: Comparison to independent-scalar soft O(R^2(log N)^2)
claims.qualification: No scalar/optimal-algorithm lower bound, timing result or factoring improvement.

claims.claim: K+m overlapping residues and convolution orientation
claims.qualification: Only K interior coefficients are promised divisible by M.

claims.claim: Signed exact convolution and all K divisions
claims.qualification: Two nonnegative packed products; unpack before subtraction; never reduce convolution mod M.
Soft O((K+R)(R ell+R+log(K+R+1))); K output costs and data traffic explicit.
Canonical endpoints checked; full unit block length less than least prime factor; no splicing after skipping nonunits.

claims.claim: Useful yield or complete factoring improvement
claims.qualification: No independence, useful support mass, deterministic cover, all-input success or successful total-work bound.
